To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
human solid tumor growth is dependent on the production of slow proliferating cancer cells.

1) AKT1low cancer cells, which are slow proliferating and tumor-initiating, are present in all human cancer cell xenographs tested; 2) AKT1-low cells are chemotherapy-resistant and are present in the tumors of patients who have been treated with chemotherapy; 3) AKT1-high cancer cells are dependent on AKT1-low cancer cells for tumor growth; 4) the AKT1-low population is not required for the growth of all cancer types;
human solid tumor growth requires the continuous production of slowly proliferating AKT1-low cancer cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the molecular mechanisms underlying cancer initiation, progression, and treatment.
the mechanisms by which human solid tumors grow.
the role of AKT1 in the biology and treatment of solid tumors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the study demonstrates a role for AKT1-low quiescent cancer cell subpopulation in tumor growth, but it is not clear if this is the only or even the main mechanism.
the AKT1low cancer cells are the most dangerous cancer cells, because they are not only the most resistant to chemotherapy, but also the ones that promote the growth of the tumor.
the study by the authors is a very nice piece of work that provides a novel and important insight into the biology of solid tumor growth.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
AKT1-E173K–mutant cancers do not produce AKT1 low cells and that this is correlated with a prolonged survival in patients.
AKT1low cells are a tumor cell state that can be targeted to treat solid tumors.
the AKT1low cancer cells are the tumor-initiating, slow proliferating and chemotherapy-resistant cells that promote solid tumor growth.
The main takeaway from our work is that
cancer cells are not all the same.
cancer cell growth depends not only on the rapidly dividing cancer cells but also requires the presence of slowly proliferating, quiescent cancer stem-like cells.
solid tumors depend on the production of slow proliferating cancer cells that are chemotherapy resistant.
